entities.summary: Dzmitry Siarhieyevich Asanau is a Belarusian professional boxer. In 2015, he won a silver medal at the European Games and a bronze at the world championships. He competed in the bantamweight event at the 2016 Summer Olympics, but was eliminated in the round of 16.
